newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end sharply higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end sharply higher on short-covering.

text.p: JGB futures ended sharply higher on short-covering, which intensified after break of key chart point, traders said.
Investors' cash JGB buying detected, particularly in intermediate sector of yield curve.
Fed rate rise helped remove one of key uncertainties.
The central bank's inaction represented an accommodative stance, as the money market was in surplus by about 110 billion yen going into the day.
